description: Published versions of SBOMBS packages. Updated by CI after successful publishes. Not the source of truth; Git tags are primary.

pypi.description: Published daily at 06:00 UTC. Version format: YYYY.M.D (UTC date).

npm.description: Published daily at 06:00 UTC. Version format: YYYY.M.D (UTC date).

pypi.description: Published once per year. Semantic versioning (YYYY.M.0). Control package for baseline testing.

npm.description: Published once per year. Semantic versioning (YYYY.M.0). Control package for baseline testing.

notes: This file is informational only and maintained by CI workflows.
It is NOT used by CI to determine versions; CI computes versions independently.
To query actual published versions, use the package registries directly.
To audit which code was published, use Git tags: git tag -l 'daily@*' or git tag -l 'yearly@*'
